Earth Cradle
Earth Cradle - Interior
Mitar: The <White Star> has vanished?
Eric: Mm-hm.
Mitar: Did it explode?
Eric: According to the Cry Wolves' report, it seems to have teleported.
Mitar: Teleported? To where?
Eric: Who can say? Only God's nose, as they say.
Mitar: God's nose...?
Eric: Er, only God knows... is what I meant.
Mitar: ...
Mitar: (Did the <Inspectors> flee, White Star and all? Or else...)
Mitar: (If the Kurogane and the Hiryu Custom vanished along with it, so much the better.)
Mitar: (Because then the Tsentr Project's results will be needed by more than just Steinbeck's faction.)
Eric: Well, well, what a pity. The White Star must've been a real treasure trove.
Mitar: Did the Cry Wolves secure the Hornedman?
Eric: No. I hear they recovered a similar unit, but it seems they dropped it in the confusion of the escape.
Mitar: Hmph... So Albero blundered.
Eric: I suppose it goes to show you can't take shortcuts. We'll just have to do it the slow way.
Mitar: And can you build a weapon capable of destroying the Granzon that way?
Eric: Well, now... maybe someone else will take care of that thing for us. Ho ho ho.
Mitar: (...And that's not a shortcut?)
Italy District - Brescia
Tochka 1 - Central Control Room
Mitar: ...The budget for the Soulgain restoration plan?
Eric: Mm-hm. Couldn't you raise it just a teensy bit more?
Mitar: ...
Eric: It may not have a teleporter, but it's a mighty fine <Super Robot>.
Eric: It could serve as a reference for the humanoid TEA we're building... and maybe even replace it, if need be.
Mitar: As you know, our budget is limited.
Eric: Well, now, couldn't you take that up with Stinepeck for me?
Mitar: ...Steinbeck. I've never met the man. Nibhal acts as his proxy.
Eric: Then with this Nibhal fellow, eh?
Mitar: I've only just asked for more funds over that item we found in the Earth Cradle. It'll be difficult.
Eric: Hmm... The Tsentr Project hasn't produced anything worth a darn yet, after all.
Mitar: Don't talk as if it's someone else's problem.
Mitar: Besides, the Jetzt cells taken from the "Head" have advanced the Flatfish Plan by leaps and bounds.
Eric: Space flounder, eh? Wonder if it tastes good. If it does, we could sell it and put the profits in the budget.
Mitar: Enough nonsense. ...I'll send you what we save by freezing the Wendigo Plan for now. Will that do?
Eric: Mm-hm. Money makes the world go wrong, as they say.
Mitar: Go round. ...Incidentally, how is that man doing?
Eric: Which one? There are two of 'em.
Mitar: The Soulgain's pilot.
Eric: That one's perfectly healthy, but he's still our sleeping prince.
Mitar: His origins aside, there's a lot about him that's suspicious.
Eric: Suspicious doesn't cover it. Unhurt despite that much damage to his unit, and stark naked when found. Shame he's a man.
Eric: And his clothes were neatly folded and set on his lap. A suspicious but tidy fellow, ho ho ho!
Mitar: In any case, don't neglect to keep an eye on him.
Eric: Mm-hm.
Mitar: (Now, next...)
Donna: You sent for me, Dr. Zapato?
Mitar: Yes. Chief Gallagher, I've decided to temporarily freeze the Wendigo Plan.
Donna: ! Why!?
Mitar: Because it hasn't produced any decent results.
Donna: Wendigo 1 aside, 2 and 3 are...!
Mitar: The units themselves pass muster, I suppose. The problem is the control system.
Donna: ...!
Mitar: As it stands, it's too much trouble to maintain. I can't submit it to the next-gen mainstay unit trials.
Donna: Then give me a chance. A chance to prove Wendigo 3's worth...!
Mitar: The Tsentr Project is not a rehabilitation center.
Donna: Ugh...
Mitar: No need to be discouraged. The Wendigo Plan isn't canceled. We'll bring in someone new and review it.
Donna: Someone new...? Who?
Mitar: Erde Mitte. You know her, don't you?
Donna: (Th-that Erde is replacing me...!? No...!)
Mitar: Take some time off. In the meantime, I'll consider a new assignment for you.
Donna: ...
Donna: (At this rate, I'll... No, more importantly...)
Donna: (Erde won't need that child... Even if the Wendigo stays, that child...)
EFA Southern Europe Command - Aviano Base
Aviano Base - Interior
Aqua: ...Professor Mitte, do you have a moment?
Erde: What is it, Aqua?
Aqua: I have a question about the lecture earlier.
Erde: All right... but could you wait a moment?
Aqua: What's that?
Erde: It's not nice to peek, Aqua.
Aqua: S-sorry...
Erde: ...These are the specs for a combat artificial intelligence.
Aqua: ! Is that classified...?
Erde: ...No. It's more of a practice piece.
Aqua: So many parasynapses... And they're connected so beautifully. This is amazing.
Erde: Oh, you can tell?
Aqua: Well, I am your student. Is it a behavior-predicting... pseudo-personality architecture?
Erde: That's a secret. It'll take quite a while to finish, anyway.
Aqua: I see...
Erde: But it's fun. Testing your own abilities... seeing how far you can go.
Erde: And raising something you created yourself. This "AIO" is like my own child.
Aqua: A-I-Zero...? Is that the combat AI's name?
Erde: Yes, that's right.
Aqua: ...Still, you really do love your work, Professor. It's kind of a waste.
Erde: What do you mean?
Aqua: Well, you're so beautiful... You're really popular with my classmates. Bet you didn't know that, huh?
Erde: I'm not interested. Right now, this AIO is everything to me.
Aqua: Then what about us students...?
Erde: Heh, who knows? Besides, I'll be going somewhere else soon.
Aqua: What, no way! Where!?
Erde: I can't tell you.
Aqua: ...I see... I'll miss you when you're gone, Professor...
Erde: ...
Erde: ...By the way, Aqua. Do you really intend to become a Personal Trooper pilot?
Aqua: Yes. I've always dreamed of it.
Erde: Do your parents approve?
Aqua: My father and I had a huge fight. Well, he was dead set against me enlisting, too...
Erde: I suppose that's understandable. The Centrum family is famous even in political circles...
Aqua: Professor, please don't...
Erde: ...
Aqua: ...I want to see what I can achieve with my own hands.
Erde: Why?
Aqua: I'm tired of being a bird in a cage. I want to choose my own path and live by my own strength.
Erde: What a waste. Had you stayed home and made the most of your station, you could've done so much more.
Erde: And you'd be happier than you are now, living a safe and peaceful life.
Aqua: But that's exactly what I don't want.
Erde: I see... Then remember this, at least.
Erde: You're an excellent student, but your weakness is that you struggle to control your emotions.
Erde: A pilot needs the ability to stay calm, analyze the situation, and handle anything, no matter what...
Erde: Without it, you'll die.
Aqua: I'll remember that, Professor Mitte...
Earth Federation Army - Incirlik Base
Incirlik Base - Interior
Kai: ...Everyone's here. We'll now begin mock combat training simulating urban warfare.
Federation Soldier: Sir!
Kai: The simulated enemy is my Gespenst. Use any formation you like and shoot me down within 10 minutes.
Federation Soldier: Roger!
Kai: Now, board the PT simulators.
Kai: Ghost 1 to all units. Recheck your settings.
Federation Soldier: Operation normal.
Kai: Don't get careless just because it's a simulator. Treat it as real combat.
Kai: It's a cliche, but anyone who takes it lightly will never improve.
Federation Soldier: Roger!
Kai: Learn from yesterday's mistakes. Whoever shoots me down gets a shochu on me.
Federation Soldier: Sir! Tonight we're drinking on you for sure!
Kai: That's the spirit. Commence the exercise!
1. Destroy all enemies.
1. Shoot down Kai.
- Meet the victory condition within 3 turns.
Kai: (Even with a bit of a handicap... I wonder how many minutes they'll last.)
- None.

Skill Points obtained.
All allied pilots get PP +5.
- None.
Kai: (...They gave me a bit more of a fight than yesterday. Quick learners, and good at varying their patterns.)
Kai: (They're worthy of having been selected as candidates, but...)
Kai: That's all for today. Compile your reports and submit them by 1900!
Kai: Also, by tomorrow morning, draw up three close-combat motion plans based on today's battle!
Federation Soldier: R-Roger...!
Turkey District - Incirlik
Kai: Phew...
Bartender: Welcome.
Kai: Can you do shochu?
Bartender: Yes. ...You've been coming every night lately. By yourself.
Kai: Yeah... well, it's not by choice that I'm alone.
Donna: ...
Kai: ...
Bartender: That lady over there has been coming every night too. Shall I introduce you?
Kai: No, thanks. I'll take the booth at the end. Bring me something to eat.
Bartender: Certainly, sir.
Kai: (Now then... I should at least look over these reports.)
Kai: (...Sorry, Commander Mustafa, but they need to be skilled enough to keep up with Lamia and the others.)
Donna: Coming to a bar dressed like that to work... So it's true the Japanese are workaholics.
Kai: ...
Donna: Am I bothering you?
Kai: No, it's not that...
Donna: Really? Good. You know, lots of people around here can't drink for religious reasons, right?
Donna: I'm getting bored of drinking alone, honestly.
Kai: Traveling?
Donna: I suppose... It's been a week since I got here. And you? On business?
Kai: Yeah, from Japan.
Donna: I'm Donna Gallagher. Meeting here must be fate. Nice to meet you.
Kai: I'm Kai... Kai Kitamura.
Earth Federation Army - Incirlik Base
Incirlik Base - Headquarters
Mustafa: ...Hangover, Major?
Kai: No, nothing like that.
Kai: (It's been a while since I drank with someone... I may have overdone it.)
Mustafa: So... will our youngsters be of any use?
Kai: Well... I expect they'll be put in charge of several verification tests for the motion data.
Mustafa: You mean they're not good enough to be full members of the Instructor Corps?
Kai: No, they're still in training, so it's hard to say...
Mustafa: Oh, no need to spare my feelings. They show promise, which is why they're learning under you, but...
Mustafa: They lack combat experience, and the veterans have their hands full with conversion training alone.
Mustafa: They're hardly fit for developing a core system.
Kai: No, the <PT> is still a new, largely unexplored machine. Developing operator skills has only just begun...
Mustafa: Well, even if it's only a few bug fixes in the system's development...
Mustafa: I think being allowed to take part will be good encouragement for the young ones.
Mustafa: Still, rumors of today's Instructor Corps reach even out here. Supposedly it's women and children.
Kai: ...
Mustafa: You, a member of the old Instructor Corps, babysitting them... I can't help worrying it's beneath you.
Mustafa: And with the Far East Branch's command passing from Laker to Kenneth Garret, isn't it difficult?
Kai: You know Commander Laker?
Mustafa: We go back decades. In any case, a man like you would be in demand as an administrator elsewhere.
Kai: No... I'd like to stay in the field as long as I can. With training my successors in mind, of course.
Mustafa: I see. Well, if anything's troubling you, feel free to come to me.
Kai: Sir... thank you very much.
Earth Federation Army - Izu Base
Izu Base - Interior
Radha: ...Word just came in from Orleans. The modified type will roll out four days behind schedule.
Kai: Then we'd better break it in at Aviano. Some may take that as a jab at the next-gen mainstay trials, though.
Radha: We need to make a showing, don't we? <Mao Industries> sees it the same way.
Kai: True, Mao isn't in a position to enter a next-gen machine in the trials...
Kai: So, has it been decided where the other two units go?
Radha: Yes. The 3rd Special Operations PT Unit, the Cry Wolves.
Kai: Oh? Major Albero's outfit...
Radha: Katina will complain when she hears about this, I'm sure.
Kai: I want opinions from outside our own unit. She'll get the next batch.
Kai: And... what about that materials theft case?
Radha: No new information has come in.
Kai: I see...
Radha: It bothers you, doesn't it?
Kai: Yes. Terrorists wouldn't steal ordinary materials for no reason.
Radha: But it's outside our jurisdiction...
Kai: Even so, something about it nags at me.
Kai: And the timing's suspect. A lot of hardware is moving around for the trials. Tell me if you learn anything.
Radha: Understood. And... don't forget to call your wife.
Kai: Right. Once things settle down at work.
Radha: I'll send you a list of souvenirs your wife and Mina would love.
Kai: Thanks, I'd appreciate it. ...I'll be in touch.
Turkey District - Incirlik
Kai: (A souvenir list... I hope it's not yoga gear. Then again, Mina might like it.)
Donna: ...Good evening. Was that a call to your wife just now?
Kai: No... not exactly.
Donna: But that's... a wedding ring, isn't it?
Kai: Yes.
Donna: Any kids?
Kai: Four... I guess.
Donna: "I guess"? What's that supposed to mean?
Kai: One daughter of my own, and three kids I look after.
Donna: I see... Is your daughter doing well?
Kai: Yes. Luckily she takes after my wife, so she's got no reason to resent me.
Donna: Then you must be lonely.
Kai: Well, I...
Donna: I have a son too. Never married, though.
Kai: So is he home alone right now?
Donna: No, I brought him along. There's a reason I can't take my eyes off him.
Kai: Is he ill... or something?
Donna: Mm... yes. He got caught in one of those alien air raids.
Donna: He survived... but from the neck down... And here I am, drinking and grumbling while he sleeps...
Donna: Some mother I am, huh?
Kai: You need to unwind when you can. If something happened to you, it's your son who'd suffer.
Donna: Yes...
Kai: You're doing what you can, aren't you? Don't think every last thing is your fault.
Donna: Maybe... it isn't that simple. The aliens mainly targeted military facilities...
Donna: If I hadn't been at that facility, he wouldn't have had to go through such pain.
Kai: You're...?
Kai: !
Donna: Right, you have to do what you can, or you'll regret it later. ...Don't you agree, Major Kai Kitamura?
Kai: ...
